hints.content: To translate $\triangle ABC$ using $(x,y)\to(x +2,y +2)$, we basically translate $\triangle ABC$'s vertices and connect them.

For example, point $\blueD{C(-6,4)}$ is translated to $(-6 +2,4 +2)=\greenD{(-4,6)}$.



[[☃ image 1]]

A dashed line The x- and y- axes scale by one. moves from vertex C two units right and two units up to a point at negative four, six.
